removed.reason: No evidence of exploiting remote services; TeamViewer use appears credential-based, and CVE-2019-3396 is a web application exploit, not remote service exploitation.
No mention of setuid or setgid abuse.
No mention of SIP or trust provider hijacking; code-signing certificates are mentioned but not this technique.
Only vague 'collect host information' is mentioned, without concrete OS or hardware detail discovery.
RDP is only mentioned as enumerated sessions for host information, not as a logon method.
No Windows service creation/modification; only Linux init script persistence is mentioned.
DLLs are mentioned as transferred payloads, but no DLL hijacking is described.
No mention of credentials stored in the Windows Registry.
Encoded/encrypted strings are used for dead drop resolvers, not symmetric encryption of C2 channels.
